title: DevBitsLab.Mcp.SourceGraph configuration (.sourcegraph.json)
description: Repo-root configuration consumed by sourcegraph-mcp at startup. Declares scopes (solution sets, project lists, or path globs) and optional plugin references.

scopes.description: One entry per indexable scope. Each scope owns its own SQLite database under .sourcegraph/scopes/<id>.db.

default_scope.description: Name of the scope used when a tool call omits the `scope` argument. Must match one of the names listed in `scopes[]`.

plugins.description: Optional plugin references. Each entry declares either a NuGet package or an on-disk DLL.

name.description: Scope identifier (kebab-case, 1-64 chars). Used as the SQLite database file name and as the value of the MCP `scope` argument.

solutions.description: Paths to .sln / .slnx files that define this scope. Mutually exclusive with `projects` and `paths`/`include`. Live indexing is currently supported only for `solutions`-based scopes.

projects.description: Paths to .csproj files. Mutually exclusive with `solutions` and `paths`/`include`. Accepted by the config loader; live indexing not yet implemented for this shape.

paths.description: Glob patterns matching .csproj files (e.g. `third_party/**/*.csproj`). Mutually exclusive with `solutions` and `projects`. Accepted by the config loader; live indexing not yet implemented.

include.description: Alias for `paths`. Same semantics, accepted for compatibility with earlier design drafts.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to subtract from this scope's project set (e.g. `**/Generated/**`).

isolated.description: When true, this scope is excluded from `scope = "*"` fan-out. Use for vendored or generated code that shouldn't pollute references on production symbols.

interop.description: Explicit native-interop target and translation units for this scope.

scope.description: A scope must declare exactly one of `solutions`, `projects`, `paths`, or `include`.

translation_units.description: Ordered native translation units and the exact compiler arguments used to parse them.

runtime_identifier.description: Runtime identifier for the ABI target, for example `win-x64`.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the native translation unit.

library.description: Native library identity associated with exports from this translation unit.

arguments.description: Exact compiler arguments used to parse this translation unit.

binary_path.description: Optional repository-relative native binary used to verify export identity.

repoRelativePath.description: A non-empty repository-relative path without parent-directory (`..`) segments.

package.description: NuGet package id. When set, `version` is also required.

version.description: NuGet package version. Required when `package` is set.

path.description: Path to a plugin DLL on disk. Mutually exclusive with `package`+`version`.

plugin.description: A plugin entry must declare exactly one of `package`+`version` or `path`.
